body.name: \(\Delta(\mathbf G,\boldsymbol\kappa)\)
body.construction: \(\Delta(\mathbf G,\boldsymbol\kappa)=\{i\in V:\exists\ell,\ell'\in L,\ \widetilde\kappa_{\ell i}(\cdot\mid x_{\operatorname{pa}_{\cup}(i)})\not\equiv\widetilde\kappa_{\ell' i}(\cdot\mid x_{\operatorname{pa}_{\cup}(i)})\}\), where every component mechanism is lifted to the common union-parent argument by ignoring coordinates outside its component-parent set.
